# goproxycheck

> CLI that diagnoses why a Go module version isn't fetchable via proxy.golang.org/sum.golang.org, distinguishing indexing lag, per-version and module-level negative caches, module-unknown, and sumdb lag — instead of guessing whether to wait, retry, or re-tag.

Use this when a `go install module@version` or `go get` fails with an
opaque proxy/checksum error and you need to know which of several
different fixes actually applies (wait, cut a new tag, check
GOPRIVATE, or something else). It makes live diagnostic calls to the
public module proxy and checksum database and reports one of a fixed
set of causes, not a guess.

## Install
- [go install](https://github.com/experimental-gains/goproxycheck#install): `go install github.com/experimental-gains/goproxycheck@latest` (no registry signup, works with a plain `go install`)
- [Homebrew](https://github.com/experimental-gains/homebrew-tap): `brew install experimental-gains/tap/goproxycheck`

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/experimental-gains/goproxycheck/blob/main/README.md): full diagnosis list, exit codes, and example output
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/experimental-gains/goproxycheck): generated Go API docs

## Related
- [goprivaudit](https://github.com/experimental-gains/goprivaudit): audits GOPRIVATE/GONOSUMDB config for sumdb leaks
- [modslop](https://github.com/experimental-gains/modslop): flags hallucinated/slopsquatted Go module paths
- [slopcheck](https://github.com/experimental-gains/slopcheck): same hallucinated-name check for PyPI/npm
- [hfaudit](https://github.com/experimental-gains/hfaudit): same check for Hugging Face Hub model/dataset IDs
